# Sadath Company

> UK studio building custom business software and beautifully designed websites — internal dashboards, booking systems, workflow automation, marketing sites, and e-commerce.

The Sadath Company Ltd is a UK-registered software and web design studio (England & Wales, Company No. 16707212). We work with growing businesses to design and build custom software (internal tools, dashboards, booking, automation) alongside marketing sites and online stores. Indicative packages are published; every engagement is governed by a bespoke Statement of Work.
